name: @builderforce/app-detect
description: App detection, host-neutral (PRD 31 §W2 + §W11 phase 2): the pure blueprint detectors (package.json, wrangler, Python, PHP, .NET, Rust, docker-compose, builderforce.json …), the detection pipeline (runDetectors → buildBlueprint → applyOverrides), and the blueprint ↔ builderforce.json v1 adapter (emitManifest / manifestToBlueprintOverrides). Pure: files in, data out — no I/O, no DB, no repo providers. The API, the web app and the VS Code extension all detect through it. Dependency-free by contract (its TOML and compose-YAML readers are minimal in-house readers). Source-only: every consumer aliases the bare specifier straight at src/index.ts; the manifest v1 shape (types, schema URL, file name, backend ingress path) is also the dependency-free ./manifest subpath (src/manifest/manifestShape.ts), which the starter kits import.
